hyperedges.label: YuCai Prototype Screen Ecosystem
hyperedges.description: yucai-finance-prototype.html serves as the hub/launcher linking to all desktop and mobile screen artifacts (dashboard, accounts, investments, transactions, budget, goals, debts, reports, settings, plus detail and form variants)

hyperedges.label: Tauri IPC Debug and Test Pattern
hyperedges.description: debug.html and test-category.html share the same Tauri IPC testing pattern: detect __TAURI__ environment, invoke Tauri commands, display JSON results in a pre element

hyperedges.label: Frontend Build Configuration Chain
hyperedges.description: package.json, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, and components.json form the frontend build configuration chain defining dependencies, TS compilation, and shadcn/ui setup

hyperedges.label: Desktop form screens share YuCai form-card + sidebar layout
Mobile detail screens share phone-frame + back-nav pattern
Desktop and mobile screens for same domain entity share data model
Desktop Page Hierarchy: List -> Detail -> Form
Debt Management Page Hierarchy: List -> Detail -> Form
Shared Design System Variables Across All Desktop Screens
YuCai Multi-Platform Prototype Screen Set
YuCai Design Tokens Shared Across All Screens
CRUD Form Pages (Desktop + Mobile)
multi-device sync subsystem: CRDT operations + version vectors + conflict resolution
core accounting data model: transactions with entries linking to accounts via double-entry bookkeeping
notification pipeline: reminders with priority tiers + notification log tracking

hyperedges.relation: debt domain FK graph: accounts<-debt_details(1:1), debt_details<-debt_payment_schedule(1:N), transactions<-debt_payment_schedule(optional)
holdings domain FK graph: accounts<-holdings, securities<-holdings, accounts<-holding_transactions, securities<-holding_transactions, transactions<-holding_transactions(optional)
core double-entry FK graph: accounts<-transaction_entries, transactions<-transaction_entries, chart_of_accounts<-transaction_entries, currencies<-accounts

hyperedges.description: Subscriptions were merged into transaction_templates: first columns were added, then data was migrated, then the subscriptions table was dropped
Four sequential migrations evolved the accounts table: loan->borrowed_in rename, liability ownership addition, created_at column, and monetary-to-cents conversion
Categories and chart_of_accounts were created, then chart_code was made nullable in transaction_entries, then unique constraint was fixed on chart_of_accounts.code
YuCai UI redesign delivered in 6 sequential phases: P0 infrastructure through P5 dashboard/reports/settings
Three page patterns (list, detail, form) share common layout components PageShell and PageHeader
P0 Task 7 creates 12 skeleton pattern components that will be used by all subsequent phases
